title: AKS Advisor: Rightsizing & Scaling Review
description: Review one HPA's replica response and sampled bounds. Read-only, name-scoped observations, not qualified advisor history.

options.content: Select an approved **Data source**, **Cluster**, **Namespace**, and **Horizontal Pod Autoscaler**. The legend lists all four series even when plotted values overlap. Missing, invalid, or ambiguous observations leave gaps, not zeros. The observed current count is **not ready replicas**. Gaps and bound states do not reveal the scaling signal or prove why the controller acted. Controller metric/target and VPA candidate telemetry require a separately verified source and are not displayed. Names can be reused; use the advisor's saved evidence to qualify controller history before changing settings.

panels.title: Observed HPA replica counts and configured bounds
Replica gap
panels.description: Observed desired minus current. Positive means fewer current than desired, negative means more. This is neither readiness lag nor evidence of unmet demand.

panels.title: Sampled HPA bound state
panels.description: Discrete evaluation points: 0 Not pinned, 1 At floor, 2 At ceiling, 3 Fixed. Floor and ceiling require both observed counts to equal that bound. Missing samples, inverted bounds, and counts outside the bounds do not produce a point. Not pinned is not a health verdict or proof of continuous activity.
